courses.summary: 以多採區露天煤礦為例，觀察供料變異、雨季排水與復育材料需求。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A multi-area open-cut coal case examines feed variation, wet-season water and rehabilitation materials. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
